name: Sticky Elementor
author: Bhumi

sections.description:
Sticky Elementor enhances the power of Elementor by allowing any container to become a sticky section with full design control and animations. This plugin lets you build eye-catching layouts, floating CTAs, sticky headers, and more — without writing code.

🌟 Key Features

  • Enable sticky scrolling for any Elementor container
  • Set custom top offset, padding, width, and background
  • Apply rotation effects (X, Y) on scroll
  • Add animations when sticky is activated (e.g., fadeIn, slideInDown)
  • Sticky trigger support (scroll behavior)
  • Multiple sticky containers per page (top, middle, or bottom)
  • Full responsive control (desktop, tablet, mobile)
  • Smooth performance with optimized JS/CSS

Perfect for sticky headers, call-to-action blocks, floating toolbars, or animated sections that activate as users scroll.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Edit any page using Elementor.
  4. Select a container → Go to Advanced tab → Sticky Settings.
  5. Enable sticky and customize position, animation, and design.
sections.faq:
Do I need Elementor Pro?

No, Sticky Elementor works with the free version of Elementor.

Can I create multiple sticky blocks on one page?

Yes. Each container can be made sticky independently.

Will this affect performance?

No. It is lightweight and optimized with minimal JS/CSS.

Can I apply entrance animations when it becomes sticky?

Yes. Choose from various animation effects like fade, slide, zoom, and more.

  • Added support for smooth transitions and additional responsive tweaks.

  • Minor code cleanup and structure improvements.

1.0.2

  • Updated all class/function/constant prefixes to meet WordPress plugin review guidelines.
  • Fixed potential class loading issues.
  • Minor code cleanup and structure improvements.

1.0.1

  • Added support for multiple sticky containers.
  • Improved JavaScript and CSS structure.
  • Minor bug fixes and compatibility updates.
